text: Toppings. What makes a bowl special is the toppings.
Crunchy. It's the crunchy granola that I love most.
Texture. The thing I hate is a watery texture.
Flavor. What I like about this flavor is that it isn't too sweet.
Scoop. All I want right now is one more scoop.
Drizzle. What I always do is drizzle honey on top.
Craving. What I have right now is a craving for something cold.
Refreshing. What makes acai so refreshing is that it's frozen.
So, what are you getting? The usual?
No way. What I want today is something different.
Try the tropical one. It's the mango that makes it amazing.
Hmm, the thing I don't like about mango is the texture.
Really? What I hate is when they put too much ice.
Me too! All I want is a thick, cold bowl with crunchy granola.
Have you ever tried it with condensed milk on top?
Yes, I have! It was my dad who showed me that, years ago.
What I love about acai is the cold texture.
It's the toppings that make it perfect.
All I want is one more scoop.
The thing I hate is a watery bowl.
What makes it refreshing is that it's frozen.

Sophia, it's Ruby! I'm at the acai place near school, and they have a new bowl. What I love about it is the peanut butter on top. And it's the banana that makes it so sweet, not sugar. The only problem is the size. It's huge! All I need now is someone to share it with. So, are you coming? What I don't want is to eat it all alone!
